idea-plugin.name: AI Engineering Fluency
idea-plugin.description:
Visualises your GitHub Copilot token usage and AI engineering fluency directly inside any JetBrains IDE.

Uses the same analytics and visualisations as the VS Code extension and Visual Studio extension; powered by a bundled native CLI so no extra runtime is required.

Source and documentation: github.com/rajbos/ai-engineering-fluency
idea-plugin.change-notes:
